title: BoundedSMP
description: Bounded SMP is a hardcore Minecraft survival server focused on high stakes, tension, and meaningful choices. Every action affects survival as players explore, complete quests, and face real consequences while the work in progress server evolves.
body:
BOUNDED SMP!

🚧 SERVER IS A WORK IN PROGRESS

Expect updates, adjustments, and experimentation. By joining early, you’re helping shape the future of the server.



DISCORD- https://discord.gg/pd2qWqHHEw


Mod Apps - https://forms.gle/gBWfGhrf6KQQECzS6





14-21 please :]


Bounded is a hardcore survival SMP built around high stakes, tension, and real consequences. — every choice you make matters.



⚔️ Hardcore Survival

Death is punishing, resources matter, and survival is never guaranteed. Progress is earned through strategy, skill points and quests




🛠 Reviving is enabled

A revival system exists, allowing fallen players a chance to return



To revive someone you must hold a totem in you off-hand and main and do /necro [​Player]

Once revived you BOTH loose 4 hearts [​heart crafting is being worked on]



. However, Bounded is currently a W.I.P, meaning mechanics, balance, and systems (including reviving) may change, improve, or be reworked over time.




📜 Spawn Quests — Main Temple

At the main spawn temple, players can receive quests that guide progression and encourage exploration. These quests may include objectives, challenges, or tasks that reward players for taking risks and engaging with the world.



🛠 Because Bounded is a W.I.P, quests may be added, changed, expanded, or rebalanced over time. New questlines and mechanics can appear as the server evolves.



The temple is more than just spawn — it’s the starting point of your journey.




🚫 NO CHEATING — ZERO TOLERANCE

This includes hacks, x-ray, exploits, dupes, macros, or unfair mods. Any attempt to gain an unfair advantage will result in punishment.


🤝 Fair Play Above All

Everyone plays under the same rules. Skill and decisions decide your fate — not shortcuts.





📅 How to Join

. Boundedsmp.modrinth.gg


⚠️ Warning

This is A Casual BUT. Expect challenge, risk, and consequences.




Once you enter, you’re not just surviving — you’re Bounded.









📜 Bounded — Server Rules




⚖️ General Conduct

• Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, or targeted abuse.

• Keep drama in-game. Real-world threats or doxxing = instant removal.




🚫 NO CHEATING — ZERO TOLERANCE

• No hacks, x-ray, exploits, dupes, macros, or unfair mods

• Texture packs that give an advantage are not allowed

• If you have to ask “is this allowed?” — assume no




⚔️ Hardcore Gameplay

• Death has consequences — don’t treat it lightly

• Reviving exists, but it is not guaranteed and may have conditions

• Abuse of revival mechanics is punishable




🌍 World & Builds

• No griefing without in-game reason or consent

• No destroying spawn, the main temple, or quest areas

• Lag machines and server-crashing builds are banned




🤝 PvP & Conflict

• PvP is allowed unless stated otherwise

• No combat logging

• No spawn camping or exploiting safe zones




🚧 Server Is a W.I.P

• Mechanics, rules, and systems may change at any time

• Staff decisions are final during testing and early access




📢 Enforcement

• Breaking rules can result in warnings, wipes, bans, or removal from revives

• Claiming ignorance is not an excuse




By playing on Bounded, you agree to follow these rules.

Survive fairly — or don’t survive at all.
